subject: Error/Bug? "NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments"

messages.author: afad425dd9c86301
messages.subject: Error/Bug? "NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments"
parts:
I'm running a cross-lagged panel model with latent trait factors for each of my variables of interest. I'd like to run regressions on each of the predictors to see what affects them. When I do, I get the error message:

Error in tmp[cbind(REP$row[idx], REP$col[idx])] <- lavpartable$free[idx] : 
  NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments

My code is as follows. It runs perfectly without the regressions on the trait factors. Once I add them in I get the message above. I should also add that votecon, econGenRetro and econPersonalRetro are all ordinal variables and treated as such in the model.

# Specify autoregression and cross-lags
votecon_2 ~ a*votecon_1 + b*econGenRetro_1 + c*econPersonalRetro_1
votecon_3 ~ a*votecon_2 + b*econGenRetro_2 + c*econPersonalRetro_2
votecon_4 ~ a*votecon_3 + b*econGenRetro_3 + c*econPersonalRetro_3

econGenRetro_2 ~ d*votecon_1 + e*econGenRetro_1 + f*econPersonalRetro_1
econGenRetro_3 ~ d*votecon_2 + e*econGenRetro_2 + f*econPersonalRetro_2
econGenRetro_4 ~ d*votecon_3 + e*econGenRetro_3 + f*econPersonalRetro_3

econPersonalRetro_2 ~ g*votecon_1 + h*econGenRetro_1 + i*econPersonalRetro_1
econPersonalRetro_3 ~ g*votecon_2 + h*econGenRetro_2 + i*econPersonalRetro_2
econPersonalRetro_4 ~ g*votecon_3 + h*econGenRetro_3 + i*econPersonalRetro_3

# Specify Covariances
votecon_1 ~~ econGenRetro_1 + econPersonalRetro_1
econGenRetro_1 ~~ econPersonalRetro_1

votecon_2 ~~ econGenRetro_2 + econPersonalRetro_2
econGenRetro_2 ~~ econPersonalRetro_2

votecon_3 ~~ econGenRetro_3 + econPersonalRetro_3
econGenRetro_3 ~~ econPersonalRetro_3

votecon_4 ~~ econGenRetro_4 + econPersonalRetro_4
econGenRetro_4 ~~ econPersonalRetro_4

# Specify random intercept/latent trait
votecon_ri =~ 1*votecon_1 + 1*votecon_2 + 1*votecon_3 + 1*votecon_4
econGenRetro_ri =~ 1*econGenRetro_1 + 1*econGenRetro_2 + 1*econGenRetro_3 + 1*econGenRetro_4
econPersonalRetro_ri =~ 1*econPersonalRetro_1 + 1*econPersonalRetro_2 + 1*econPersonalRetro_3 + 1*econPersonalRetro_4

votecon_ri ~~ econGenRetro_ri + econPersonalRetro_ri
econGenRetro_ri ~~ econPersonalRetro_ri

# Specify controls for traits
votecon_ri ~ 1 + age
econGenRetro_ri ~ 1 + age
econPersonalRetro_ri ~ 1 + age
